I fixed the Household expenses page so it now follows the app's light and dark mode. Before, it had a hardcoded white background and fixed greys, which is why it glared at night.

It now uses the app's own theme colors for the background, text, row dividers and category pills. I didn't change the layout or the note's data. I haven't viewed it in dark mode, so check the Page tab. The previous version of the page is kept if you want to go back.
